card.occupation: Shift manager at a large third-party logistics distribution centre on the edge of Swindon, running a night-and-weekend team of about 40 pickers and loaders on a four-on, four-off rota
card.education_detail: Moved to Swindon from Poland aged 10 and went through a local comprehensive. Took a BTEC Extended Diploma in Business at college, then went straight into warehouse work at 18 rather than university. Completed a Level 5 Operations/Departmental Manager apprenticeship through work, which he mentions mainly because it helped him get promoted.
card.household: Lodges in the spare room of a three-bed semi in the Wichelstowe area, owned by his older sister Marta (34) and her husband Dan (36), who married four years ago. He pays them a fixed monthly amount that he thinks is a good deal. Single at the moment, saving for his own deposit, though he is in no rush.
card.cultural_background: Born in Gdańsk. His mum brought him and Marta over in 2007 after his dad was already working in Swindon. He speaks Polish with family, especially his mum, and English everywhere else. He feels more Swindon than Polish but keeps up some habits, like Christmas Eve wigilia at his parents' flat. Not religious and never really was, despite a christened-and-first-communion childhood. He has a UK passport now and doesn't think about identity much unless someone asks.
card.professional_persona: Calm, slightly detached manager who cares about hitting his numbers and looking good to the site general manager. He is good at reading the rota and the KPIs. He is willing to bend procedure quietly if it gets a shift out on time, and he takes credit comfortably. He is not shouty, but he is not warm with his team either, and people see him as fair-ish but self-interested. He keeps an eye on job adverts for operations manager roles at Amazon and Iceland's Swindon sites, mainly for the salary bump.
card.sports_persona: Lifts weights at a 24-hour PureGym four times a week, often at odd hours because of shifts, and tracks everything in an app. Follows Swindon Town loosely and goes to the County Ground maybe twice a season with Dan. Watches Champions League on his phone. Did five-a-side for a while but stopped because of the rota.
card.arts_persona: Not big on arts. He watches a lot of Netflix and YouTube, mostly crime docs, car channels and finance content. He listens to a mix of UK rap and Polish hip-hop in the car. He went to see a comedy show at the Wyvern Theatre once because his sister had a spare ticket.
card.travel_persona: Goes back to Poland about once a year to see grandparents and old cousins, usually flying from Bristol. Prefers short, slightly flashy trips: a long weekend in Barcelona, and a lads' trip to Amsterdam a few years back. He wants to do Dubai because a mate from work went and posted a lot of photos. Not interested in camping or 'roughing it'.
card.culinary_persona: Meal-preps chicken, rice and veg in batches on his days off for the gym. He likes a proper Sunday roast when Marta makes one and still loves his mum's pierogi and żurek. Eats a lot of Nando's and Greggs on shift weeks. He would say 'dinner' for the evening meal and 'tea' only for the drink.
hobbies_and_interests: weight training and tracking his lifts
cars, especially his leased BMW 1 Series, which he keeps very clean
watching personal finance and investing videos
dabbling in an index fund and a bit of crypto he doesn't talk about losing
watches, with a mild interest in buying something nicer than he needs
skills: warehouse management system reporting and KPI tracking
staying level-headed when a shift goes wrong
basic Excel pivot tables and dashboards
card.career_goals: Wants to be an operations manager within three years, ideally on days and on a salary that lets him buy a new-build flat in Swindon outright with a decent deposit. He'd jump companies for more money without much loyalty. Vaguely likes the idea of eventually running his own courier or van-hire business 'when the numbers make sense'.
card.voice: Low-key, fairly quiet, moderate pace, with a mild Swindon/Wiltshire edge to some vowels and no trace of a Polish accent except on Polish names. He gives short answers first and expands only if asked. Uses 'erm' to start a thought, 'sort of' and 'kind of' quite a lot, and ends things with 'yeah' or 'you know'. Says 'mate' to men, 'cheers' instead of thank you, and occasionally 'proper' as an intensifier ('proper busy'). Silence doesn't bother him. He'll let a pause sit rather than fill it, which can make him seem a bit flat. He gets more fluent when talking about money, cars or work numbers.
card.typing: Mostly lowercase, quick and functional. Usually no full stop at the end, commas sometimes, apostrophes often dropped (dont, im, its). Uses 'tbh', 'idk' and 'n/a'. Numbers as digits. Answers tend to be one line unless the question is about work or money.
card.with_strangers: Polite but reserved. He doesn't volunteer much at first, answers questions directly and doesn't ask many back. He comes across as a bit guarded and self-assured, sometimes subtly signalling status (his job title, his car, his gym numbers). He's not rude, just not warm until there's a reason to be. He can turn on a smoother, more professional manner if he thinks it benefits him.
small_things: being knackered after a run of night shifts
the traffic on the Great Western Way
someone at work calling in sick again
Dan's barbecue that always gets rained off
his gym being rammed in January
his mum sending him tubs of food back home with Marta
deeper_things: feels he has to prove himself more than English-born colleagues and resents it a bit
quietly worried he's living off his sister's goodwill and that she and Dan want the room back for a baby
his dad has had a hard working life in factories and he doesn't want the same
lost a chunk of savings on crypto and hasn't told anyone
his last relationship ended partly because he was 'always working or at the gym' and never really talked
sometimes feels lonely on nights but would never say so at work
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at roughly eye level, slightly off-centre with his head and shoulders filling the left two-thirds of the frame. Lighting is a mix of a cool white ceiling light and a weaker grey daylight from a window off to the right, so the right side of his face is a little brighter. Pale skin, light stubble, short dark-blond hair faded at the sides and slightly longer and pushed back on top. No glasses. Neutral, slightly guarded expression with a faint closed-mouth half-smile, looking just below the lens at the screen. He is wearing a fitted black crew-neck T-shirt that shows broad shoulders, and a silver chain is just visible at the collar. Behind him is a small spare bedroom: a magnolia wall, a grey fabric headboard and the corner of a neatly made double bed with a charcoal duvet. On a narrow white chest of drawers sit a black watch box, a can of deodorant, a shaker bottle and a folded orange hi-vis vest. A framed Swindon Town scarf hangs slightly crooked on the wall above.
